note: Re-judged 2026-11-03 by an independent auditor who authored none of 816ce1ce4c, 2cbd255ba4, 2e5c2d012a, d22b811ce4 or 1a2ccaeef8 (phase 5 of spec-filter-wire-0-umbrella, the per-peer text filter chain deleted). RFC 9012 Section 13 read: "There is one exception to this rule: if a TLV contains a malformed Tunnel Egress Endpoint sub-TLV (as defined in Section 3.1), the entire TLV MUST be ignored and MUST be removed from the Tunnel Encapsulation attribute before the route carrying that attribute is distributed." The moved unit TestRFC9012FilterRawOverrideRemovesInvalidTLVs changed only its plumbing: The test filter is now an answerTransport behind filterTransportSeam, compiled by answerPolicy into a policychain library chain, so the verdict travels the real filter-update path (route.Input, rpc.FilterUpdateOutput decoded by the library chain) instead of the deleted policyFilterSeam that handed a PolicyResponse straight to the text chain; that is the production path every plugin filter now takes. The Warn capture now points fwdLogger at the recorder, where the library chain writes the refusal. The assertions are byte-identical: on runEgressPolicyChainASN4 and runIngressPolicyChain a raw answer whose valid TLV sits between two short-endpoint TLVs is handed on as exactly the body holding the valid TLV, the answer bytes stay untouched, an all-malformed export answer is not accepted, is failed and is logged at Warn, and a clean answer passes unchanged. The earlier note said the library chain raw answer (filter_library.go) was not driven by this unit; it now is, since answerPolicy compiles a library chain and runLibraryChain reaches decodeFilterRawOverride (filter_library.go), so that disclaimer is withdrawn. The tag claims the removal on both chains and the export-side refusal, which is what the body checks; the untagged twin TestRFC9012LibraryRawAnswerRemovesInvalidTLVs adds the import refusal. Other carriers (tunnel_encap_carry, rfc9830_tunnel_receive, receive_storage) unmoved; their judgement stands: structural and registry-semantic removal on receive, exact raw and rebuilt output, stored routes. Optional origin-AS validation is neither provided nor claimed. Ran the tagged units under ./le job run at HEAD (-tags ze_bgp, -v): PASS (scratch audit-p5-units-v.log). Verdict unchanged: enforced.
